'''Nank Tun''' was an [[Aqualish]] who served as an [[aide]] to [[Senator]] [[Po Nudo]] throughout the [[Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
As the [[Clone Wars]] erupted across [[the galaxy]], Tun remained close to Nudo, [[Advisor|advising]] the [[Aqualish]] on matters relating to his position on the [[Executive Separatist Council|Separatist Council]].<ref name="ROTS" /> As an [[aide]], they wrote drafts, sent secret messages, and managed Nudo's meetings.<ref name="VE" /> When the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] leadership was sent to [[Mustafar]], Tun joined Nudo and the other leaders at the [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility]] where the Confederacy's mysterious benefactor [[Darth Sidious]] assured they would be safe. Welcoming Sidious' [[Sith apprentice|apprentice]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], the Aqualish and the rest of the Separatist Council soon realized they were in danger. Cowering alongside Nudo as Vader ignited [[Skywalker lightsaber|his]] [[lightsaber]], Nank Tun's protective breastplate did nothing to stop the [[Color|blue]]-bladed weapon as it struck, [[Death|killing]] them instantly. Vader would then [[Mission to Mustafar|finish off]] the rest of the Council.<ref name="ROTS" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] continuity, Tun was a [[Shi'ido]] [[Changeling|shapeshifter]] posing as an Aqualish,<ref name="AOTC:VD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> but the [[canon]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' described the aide as a real Aqualish.<ref name="VE" /> They were played by a [[Tim Gibbons]] in all the prequels.
